# Phyloseq-object_all-batches

## Background
In this script, the meta data file and the tax table and sequence table from the DADA2 pipeline are combined to a phyloseq object. 

## Packages

```{r Packages}
#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#  install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install()
packageVersion("BiocManager") # Version 1.30.23

#"DADA2" for sequence processing
#BiocManager::install("dada2", version = "3.9")
library(dada2)

#"phyloseq" for data analysis
#BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
library(phyloseq)

#"tidyverse" for data organization
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

#"here" for easily locating files
#install.packages("here")
library(here)
```


## Loading in data

```{r Loading in data}

load(here("results/taxa-table_environment.RData"))

Meta_data_1 <- read.csv(here("SVN_Microbiome_Meta-data_curated_full.csv"))

```

## Prepping data
It is essential to ensure that the sample IDs and the fastq file IDs are the same and in the correct order. 

```{r Confirming row names are the same}
#Order row names and remove rows without 16S data


merge_tables_all_batches_2 <- as.data.frame(merge_tables_all_batches)
merge_tables_all_batches_2 <- merge_tables_all_batches_2 %>% 
  rownames_to_column() 

merge_tables_all_batches_2 <-rename(merge_tables_all_batches_2, fastq_ID = rowname)

merge_tables_all_batches_2 <- merge_tables_all_batches_2 %>% 
select(fastq_ID)

Meta_data_2 <- left_join(merge_tables_all_batches_2, distinct(Meta_data_1, fastq_ID, .keep_all = TRUE))

Meta_data_2 <- column_to_rownames(Meta_data_2, var = "fastq_ID")


# Ensure metadata and seqtab rows are in the same order.
all(rownames(Meta_data_2) == rownames(merge_tables_all_batches))


```

## Making phyloseq object

```{r Creating phyloseq object}

#combining tax table, meta data, and sequence table into one phyloseq object
phyloseq_object_1 <- phyloseq(otu_table(merge_tables_all_batches, taxa_are_rows=FALSE), sample_data(Meta_data_2), tax_table(All_Batches_taxa))

# Assign ASVs arbitrary names for visibility.
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(phyloseq_object_1))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(phyloseq_object_1)
phyloseq_object_1 <- merge_phyloseq(phyloseq_object_1, dna)
taxa_names(phyloseq_object_1) <- paste0("ASV", seq(ntaxa(phyloseq_object_1)))

```

```{r}
ps_analysis_1 <- phyloseq_object_1 # Generate new phyloseq object for downstream analysis. Keeping original phyloseq object for reference.


# Keep only Bacterial reads. Remove Mitochondria/Chloroplast reads and taxa with 
ps_analysis_1 <- subset_taxa(ps_analysis_1,
                           Kingdom == "Bacteria" &
                             Family != "Mitochondria" &
                             Family != "Chloroplast") 

# removing samples with 0 reads.
ps_analysis_1 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_analysis_1) > 0, ps_analysis_1)


#Sample characteristics
dim(ps_analysis_1@otu_table)
total_reads <- sample_sums(ps_analysis_1)
sum(total_reads) 
mean(total_reads) 
median(total_reads) 
range(total_reads) 
```


## Saving environment

```{r removing unneeded objects}

rm(total_reads, dna, merge_tables_all_batches_2, Meta_data_1)

```

```{r saving environment}

save.image(here("results/phyloseq_environment.RData"))

```


## Loading in data

```{r Making one table to track reads through DADA2 pipeline}

#Loading in track tables
track_1 <- read_csv("results/tables/Batch_1_track.csv") %>% 
  mutate(Batch = "Batch_1")
track_2 <- read_csv("results/tables/Batch_2_track.csv")%>% 
  mutate(Batch = "Batch_2")
track_3 <- read_csv("results/tables/Batch_3_track.csv")%>% 
  mutate(Batch = "Batch_3")
track_4 <- read_csv("results/tables/Batch_4_track.csv")%>% 
  mutate(Batch = "Batch_4")


#Joining track tables for all batches
track_all <- full_join(track_1, track_2) %>% 
  full_join(track_3) %>% 
  full_join(track_4) %>% 
  mutate(Percent_filtered = filtered/input*100)%>% 
  mutate(Percent_merged = merged/input*100) %>% 
  mutate(Delta_input = input-nonchim)


```


##Filtering samples

```{r Viewing %filtered reads}

track_plot <- ggplot(track_all, aes(x=Batch, y=Percent_input)) + 
  geom_boxplot()

track_plot

track_plot_graph<- ggplot(track_all, aes(x=Percent_input, y=Percent_filtered, fill = Batch)) + 
  geom_point( aes(color = Batch))+
  labs(x = "Percent Assigned ASVs of Input Reads", y = "Percent Reads Filtered of Input Reads", title = "Sample Quality") +
  theme(#legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        #aspect.ratio = 1, 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 18)) 

track_plot_graph

```


```{r Filtering samples}

#filtering samples
track_all_2 <- track_all %>% 
  filter(Percent_input >= 50) %>% #Samples must have >= 50% of their initial number of reads
  filter(Percent_filtered >= 65) %>% #After "filter and trim" samples must have >= 65% of initial reads
  filter(input >= 20000) #Samples must have >= 20000 initial reads


#plotting remaining samples
track_plot_2 <- ggplot(track_all_2, aes(x=Batch, y=Percent_input)) + 
  geom_boxplot()

track_plot_2

track_plot_graph_2<- ggplot(track_all_2, aes(x=Percent_input, y=Percent_filtered, fill = Batch)) + 
  geom_point( aes(color = Batch))+
  geom_smooth(method=lm, se=FALSE)

track_plot_graph_2

```


```{r Making phyloseq with only remaining samples}

filtered_names <- track_all_2[["...1"]]

ps_analysis_2 <- prune_samples(filtered_names, ps_analysis_1)

```


```{r Reviewing remaining samples}

# Review ASV and sample numbers.
dim(ps_analysis_1@otu_table)
dim(ps_analysis_2@otu_table) # Lost 3277 ASVs, 131 samples removed

```


## Summary

At this point, all batches have been through the DADA2 pipeline and have been merged together. Taxonomy has been assigned. Phyloseq object has been generated. Low quality samples have been removed. Objects, formulas, etc. that are not needed for future steps have been removed. 

For future steps, load the current environment.

```{r Saving environment}
#saving full environment
save.image(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_full_environment.RData"))

```


```{r Saving environment}
#removing unneeded objects: some objects useful for later reference are kept
rm(track_1, track_2, track_3, track_4, track_plot, track_plot_2, track_plot_graph, track_plot_graph_2, filtered_names)

#saving smaller environment
save.image(here("results/filtered_dada_2_output_environment.RData"))

```
